item.title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
item.description: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

item.title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
item.description: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

item.title: OpenAI caught Russians and Iranians using ChatGPT for influence campaigns
item.description: The company says Russian operatives used its AI chatbot to update their bosses, shedding light on influence campaigns previously not attributed to Russia.

item.title: Backlash as American tech giants look to build data centers in Australia
item.description: Facing legal challenges and public backlash at home, American tech giants are looking abroad for new opportunities in Australia. But the reception down under may not be quite as warm as they hope.

item.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software sent humans to the moon, dies at 90
item.description: Hamilton was in her early thirties when she led the team of software engineers that powered NASA's Apollo missions. She later said, "There was no choice but to be pioneers."

item.title: After bankruptcy, he was banned from sports betting sites. Then he discovered Kalshi
item.description: The dark side of the prediction market boom is becoming more clear: Experts say the sites have become go-to outlets for gambling addicts to relapse as the companies avoid state consumer protections.
